faq.q: Which CRMs and tools does it connect to?
faq.a: Agents reach Salesforce, HubSpot, Gmail, Outlook, Slack, and calendars through connected accounts. You sign in once through Composio; tokens stay with Composio, not the agent.

faq.q: How do I keep outreach on-brand?
faq.a: Agents draft from each account's research and the examples you give them. You review and send, so every message that goes out is yours.

faq.q: Can I control what an agent is allowed to do?
faq.a: Yes. Choose which connected tools an agent may use, and require approval before it sends. Run history shows what ran; not every external action is logged.
